scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 7(1), (1A), (1C)(a), 8(1D)-(1G), 9ZA(2)-(3), 9A(2), (6), 34(1), 36(1)-(1A), 36A(2), 59A(1)-(2), 59B(1), (3)-(4), (6) of the revised text as at 25 June 2026. Left out on purpose: other returns, enquiry substance, appeals, claims, interest and penalties, PAYE.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 100 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); three failed (s 9A(6) defines the filing date for enquiries as the s 8 deadline, not the s 9ZA(3) date) and the encoding was corrected. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: Year 2: its 31 October is Y+1, its 31 January Y+2.
forks.F2: 3 months beginning with the notice: day before the corresponding date.
forks.F3: Notices on 31 July / 31 October fall outside Exceptions 1 / 2.
forks.F4: s 9A(2)(a): corresponding date 12 months after delivery; the filing date is s 9A(6)'s (the s 8 deadline).
forks.F5: Quarter day strictly after the anniversary.
forks.F8: 5 April 4/6/12/20 years after the end of the year.
